summary_en: This Phase II study tests Ruvidar (TLD-1433) with photodynamic therapy (PDT) in adults with non-muscle invasive bladder cancer that is carcinoma in situ, with or without papillary disease (Ta, T1), and that is unresponsive to or intolerant of BCG. Ruvidar is infused into the bladder for about 60 minutes, then rinsed out, and the bladder wall is treated with PDT light using the TLC-3200 system; one procedure is given, with up to two re-induction procedures based on response. The record does not state the main outcome measure; the study is Phase II, single-arm and open-label.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase II evalúa Ruvidar (TLD-1433) con terapia fotodinámica (PDT) en adultos con cáncer de vejiga no músculo invasivo, con carcinoma in situ, con o sin enfermedad papilar (Ta, T1), que no responde a BCG o no lo tolera. Ruvidar se infunde en la vejiga durante unos 60 minutos y luego se enjuaga; después, la pared de la vejiga se trata con luz PDT usando el sistema TLC-3200, y se realiza un procedimiento, con hasta dos procedimientos de re-inducción según la respuesta. El registro no indica la medida de resultado principal; el estudio es de fase II, de un solo brazo y abierto.
who_for: Bladder carcinoma in situ, with or without papillary disease, that is BCG-unresponsive or BCG-intolerant
Not a candidate for cystectomy on medical grounds, or refuses radical cystectomy
Satisfactory bladder function and able to retain the study drug for at least 60 minutes
not_for: Past or current muscle-invasive or metastatic urothelial carcinoma
Another malignancy that is progressing or needs active treatment
Participation in an investigational agent or device study within 1 month
Active infection requiring systemic therapy, or pregnancy or breastfeeding
